the_fleet_as_brain.analogy: The human brain: 86B neurons, ~20W, processes reality in real-time. It doesn't brute-force every photon — it PREDICTS and only processes CHANGES (saccadic masking, change blindness, predictive coding). The brain IS an inversion engine.

kevin_fleet_as_brain.neurons_equivalent: 256GB GPU VRAM + 1.5TB RAM = ~1.7TB addressable memory. A synapse is ~4 bytes. That's ~425 billion synapses. The human brain has ~100-500 trillion. Kevin's fleet is 0.1-0.4% of a brain by synapse count.
kevin_fleet_as_brain.but: A GPU FLOP is not a synaptic operation. A GPU can execute a synapse-equivalent in 1 clock cycle. At 848 TFLOPS, Kevin's fleet does 848 trillion operations per second. The human brain does ~10^16 operations per second. Kevin's fleet is 8.5% of a brain by operations.
kevin_fleet_as_brain.with_inversion: 636x effective = 539 PFLOPS = 539,000 TFLOPS. That's 54% of human brain equivalent operations. HALF A BRAIN. On consumer hardware. In a basement.
